inShort: A and B stand a step behind the kitchen line and volley hard with a fuller swing, stepping into every ball. 10 in a row.
rules: A and B stand about 1.5–2 m behind the kitchen line, straight across.
A starts with an easy ball, then both volley back and forth at pace.
Take a bigger swing than at the line: you have more time, so use it for pace.
Step into every ball, weight moving forward.
Hit every ball back at body height.
Go for 10 hard exchanges in a row without a miss.
tooEasy: Move closer to the kitchen line, so you have less time. Even harder: a ball hit off the back foot breaks the streak.
tooHard: Move further back for more time, and play at medium pace.
goodLooksLike: Each swing ends with the weight on the front foot, and the ball travels low and fast over the net instead of floating up.
